name: Intercontinental Paris - Avenue Marceau
insider_take: Housed in a stunning 1889 Haussmanian building, this refined retreat puts you steps from the Arc de Triomphe in the heart of Paris's most prestigious district.
whats_special: This boutique InterContinental occupies a historic mansion originally built during Baron Haussmann's transformation of Paris. The hotel's intimate scale (only 64 rooms) and prime location on Avenue Marceau place you in the Golden Triangle, where luxury shopping meets Parisian elegance. The building's Belle Époque architecture has been meticulously preserved while incorporating modern luxury amenities.
pro_tip: Book a room facing Avenue Marceau for stunning views of the Arc de Triomphe, especially magical when illuminated at night. The hotel's concierge can arrange exclusive after-hours shopping experiences at nearby Champs-Élysées boutiques.
dont_miss: Take the 3-minute stroll to Place Charles de Gaulle to experience the Arc de Triomphe up close, then explore the nearby Avenue des Champs-Élysées. The hotel's location also provides easy access to the Palais de Tokyo contemporary art museum and the fashionable Trocadéro district across the Seine.
pros: Prime location near Champs-Élysées and Arc de Triomphe
Luxurious accommodations with elegant Parisian design
Exceptional concierge and personalized guest services
World-class dining options and sophisticated bar
cons: Busy central location with urban atmosphere
